calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
  AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 'sales' AS src, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line,
       min(sale_date) AS min_d, max(sale_date) AS max_d, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS load_stamps, min(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), NULL, NULL, NULL
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cs.region, count(*) AS stores, SUM(m.mine) AS mine, SUM(c.ctl) AS control, SUM(m.mine) - SUM(c.ctl) AS gap
FROM dim_store cs
LEFT JOIN mine m ON m.store_id = cs.store_id
LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = cs.store_id
WHERE cs.is_current
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
